summary: Admit a live value across suspension only when its continuation-frame disposition and loan lifetime are statically closed.
requires: compute exact liveness after the suspension point
resolve the originating loan and referent storage duration
end every non-static loan before suspension commit
preconditions: resolve one suspension point and its post-suspension liveness set
resolve every live place to one owner and at most one active loan
normalization: normalize aliases, place identity, owner identity, loan kind, referent storage duration, cleanup tokens, and managed roots before classification
decision_procedure: classify a value not live after suspension as NOT_LIVE_AFTER_SUSPEND
classify a live reusable value as REUSABLE_COPY and a live owned transferable value as OWNED_TRANSFER
classify a live immutable shared borrow as STATIC_SHARED_BORROW only when its referent has static storage duration
reject every other live stack, region, inout, exclusive, temporary-view, callback, or borrowed-Facet loan before FRAME_SUSPEND_COMMIT
prefer FACET_BORROW_CROSSES_SUSPENSION for a borrowed Facet and otherwise emit BORROW_CROSSES_SUSPENSION
termination_metric: finite live-place set and one finite owner/loan resolution per place
success_result: admit with one exact continuation-frame slot disposition per live place
evaluation_order: preconditions -> liveness -> owner/loan normalization -> slot classification -> specific-before-generic diagnostic

summary: R30 closed deterministic admission algorithm for cleanup-free same-type semantic value duplication; production checker remains NOT_RUN.
requires: resolve the sealed internal CopyValue ResponsibilityRuleId without a public Copy Trait or source conformance
the normalized type is Reusable and carries no cleanup, borrow, raw pointer, provenance, callable environment, shared-handle, or authority responsibility
one registered owner-closed copy law preserves the source and produces an independent result of the exact same type
the copy operation has no error row, effect row, suspension, cancellation, or new cleanup obligation
preconditions: resolve the exact internal CopyValue ResponsibilityRuleId
reject source spelling, direct conformance, and public Copy Trait lookup
require a finite owner-closed normalized component graph and registered copy laws
normalization: expand transparent type aliases, resolve the exact internal ResponsibilityRuleId and TypeId, preserve ordered components, then evaluate the finite owner-closed copy-law graph
decision_procedure: reject unknown, stale, forged, or source-spelled identity with RESPONSIBILITY_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED
reject Resource or Affine cleanup, live borrow, shared handle, raw/provenance, callable environment, authority, or direct conformance with RESPONSIBILITY_EVIDENCE_NOT_ADMISSIBLE
require one registered copy law for the owner and every ordered component; evaluate the finite memoized graph without provider or runtime search
require source-remains-live and exact-same-TypeId result while error/effect rows and new cleanup obligations remain empty
emit one digest-bound intrinsic ResponsibilityEvidenceDescriptor before the capture environment commit
termination_metric: finite normalized type graph plus finite registered copy-law table and memoized SCC state
evaluation_order: identity -> alias normalization -> negative gates -> finite copy-law derivation -> source/result preservation -> evidence digest -> diagnostic
